scope: Cal State LA HRFF public-data lead inspection

sources.title: Big Data Prediction in Hydrogen Gas Power Plant using Apache Spark
sources.evidence: The paper states that fueling details were recorded for each fill and that a raw dataset was used for prediction.
sources.reason: The PDF is a publication, not a downloadable synchronized logger archive. A custodian request is required before any numerical outcome can be inspected.

sources.title: Hydrogen station in situ back-to-back fueling data for design and modeling
sources.evidence: The article describes a comprehensive one-year HRFF data set with pressure, thermodynamics, cooling response and vehicle SOC analyses.
sources.reason: The public article and figures do not expose the synchronized logger export or written reuse terms required for a frozen independent holdout.

sources.title: Cal State LA Hydrogen Research and Fueling Facility
sources.evidence: The official page confirms the real station and its research/data-collection role.
sources.reason: Facility context supports a credible data-custodian route but is not a process-data file.

next_action: Use the prepared Cal State LA data-request draft; if files are released, hash-lock them and freeze the no-fitting split before reading outcomes.
